arxiv-2105-02181.creator: NGUYEN BIN
arxiv-2105-02181.description: Abstract In this note, we construct two minimal surfaces of general type with geometric genus p g = 3 p_{g}=3 , irregularity q = 0 q=0 , self-intersection of the canonical divisor K 2 = 20 , 24 K^{2}=20,24 such that their canonical map is of degree 20 20 .

arxiv-2108-10631.title: On Z-mean reflected BSDEs
arxiv-2108-10631.creator: Joffrey Derchu, Thibaut Mastrolia
arxiv-2108-10631.description: Abstract In this paper we provide conditions for the existence of supersolutions to BSDEs with mean-reflections on the Z Z component. We show that, contrary to BSDEs with mean-reflections on the Y Y component, we cannot expect a supersolution with a deterministic increasing process K K .

arxiv-2408-06039.title: Spacetime E ⁡ ( n ) E(n) -Transformer: Equivariant Attention for Spatio-temporal Graphs
arxiv-2408-06039.creator: Sergio G. Charles
arxiv-2408-06039.description: Abstract We introduce an E ⁡ ( n ) E(n) -equivariant Transformer architecture for spatio-temporal graph data. By imposing rotation, translation, and permutation equivariance inductive biases in both space and time, we show that the Spacetime E ⁡ ( n ) E(n) -Transformer (SET) outperforms purely spatial and temporal models without symmetry-preserving properties.

arxiv-2409-00119.title: 3-in-1: 2D Ro tary Ad aptation for Efficient Finetuning, Efficient Batching and Composability
arxiv-2409-00119.creator: Baohao Liao Christof Monz
arxiv-2409-00119.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Baohao Liao Christof Monz. Parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) methods effectively adapt large language models (LLMs) to diverse downstream tasks, reducing storage and GPU memory demands. Despite these advantages, several applications pose new challenges to PEFT beyond mere parameter efficiency. One notable challenge involves the efficient deployment of LLMs equipped with multiple task- or user-specific adapters, particularly when different adapters are needed for distinct requests within the same batch. Another challenge is the interpretability of LLMs, which is crucial for understanding how LLMs function.

arxiv-2411-11907.title: LoRA Unlearns More and Retains More (Student Abstract)
arxiv-2411-11907.creator: Atharv Mittal
arxiv-2411-11907.description: Abstract Due to increasing privacy regulations and regulatory compliance, Machine Unlearning (MU) has become essential. The goal of unlearning is to remove information related to a specific class from a model. Traditional approaches achieve exact unlearning by retraining the model on the remaining dataset, but incur high computational costs.

arxiv-2412-08641.title: 3D Mesh Editing using Masked LRMs
arxiv-2412-08641.creator: Will Gao 1∗ Dilin Wang 2 Yuchen Fan 2 Aljaz Bozic 2 Tuur Stuyck 2 Zhengqin Li 2 Zhao Dong 2 Rakesh Ranjan 2 Nikolaos Sarafianos 2 1 University of Chicago, 2 Meta Reality Labs MaskedLRM Website
arxiv-2412-08641.description: Abstract We present a novel approach to shape editing, building on recent progress in 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. We formulate shape editing as a conditional reconstruction problem, where the model must reconstruct the input shape with the exception of a specified 3D region, in which the geometry should be generated from the conditional signal.

arxiv-2508-00384.title: On Learning Closed-Loop Probabilistic Multi-Agent Simulator
arxiv-2508-00384.creator: Juanwu Lu, Rohit Gupta, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Kyungtae Han, Ruqi Zhang, Ziran Wang
arxiv-2508-00384.description: Abstract The rapid iteration of autonomous vehicle (AV) deployments leads to increasing needs for building realistic and scalable multi-agent traffic simulators for efficient evaluation. Recent advances in this area focus on closed-loop simulators that enable generating diverse and interactive scenarios.

arxiv-2508-07110.title: Physical Design Exploration of a Wire-Friendly Domain-Specific Processor for Angstrom-Era Nodes
arxiv-2508-07110.creator: Lorenzo Ruotolo, Lara Orlandic, Pengbo Yu, Moritz Brunion, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Dwaipayan Biswas, Giovanni Ansaloni, David Atienza, Julien Ryckaert, Francky Catthoor, Yukai Chen
arxiv-2508-07110.description: Abstract This paper presents the physical design exploration of a domain-specific processor (DSIP) architecture targeted at machine learning (ML), addressing the challenges of interconnect efficiency in advanced Angstrom-era technologies. The design emphasizes reduced wire length and high core density by utilizing specialized memory structures and SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) units.

pmc-10579100.creator: Gabriela Rios Martini, Ekaterina Tikhonova, Elisa Rosati, Meghan Bialt DeCelie, Laura Katharina Sievers, Florian Tran, Matthias Lessing, Arne Bergfeld, Sophia Hinz, Susanna Nikolaus, Julia Kümpers, Anna Matysiak, Philipp Hofmann, Carina Saggau, Stephan Schneiders, Ann-Kristin Kamps, Gunnar Jacobs, W
pmc-10579100.description: Aberrant CD4+ T cell reactivity against intestinal microorganisms is considered to drive mucosal inflammation in inflammatory bowel diseases. The disease-relevant microbial species and the corresponding microorganism-specific, pathogenic T cell phenotypes remain largely unknown. In the present study, we identified common gut commensal and food-derived yeasts, as direct activators of altered CD4+ T cell reactions in patients with Crohn’s disease (CD).

pmc-11609239.title: Quantifying residents' exposure to agricultural pesticides using new geospatial approaches
pmc-11609239.creator: Sarah Habran, Christelle Philippart, Vincent Van Bol, Raphaël D'Andrimont, Hervé Breulet
pmc-11609239.description: A better understanding of environmental exposure to agricultural pesticides is crucial for public health, regulatory and management purposes. Residents in close vicinity to agricultural fields are likely to be more exposed to pesticides. In that context, an innovative geospatial approach for mapping estimates of agricultural pesticide exposure was developed in this study.

pmc-12620628.title: Dual-Function Biomaterials for Postoperative Osteosarcoma: Tumor Suppression and Bone Regeneration
pmc-12620628.creator: Hui Dong, Qing-Yi Zhang, Zi-Yuan Feng, Kai Huang, Rong Nie, Lu Li, Hong Duan, Hui-Qi Xie
pmc-12620628.description: Osteosarcoma, a primary malignant bone tumor originating from mesenchymal cells, is the most prevalent bone malignancy in children and adolescents. Current standard treatment involves aggressive surgical resection aimed at maximal tumor removal; however, this inevitably creates extensive bone defects that substantially impair patients’ quality of life. Furthermore, the risks of postoperative tumor recurrence and metastasis critically influence therapeutic outcomes.

pmc-13625653.title: MMP2Mol: a matched molecular pairs-based framework for ligand-based de novo drug design
pmc-13625653.creator: Dekun Chen, Hui Li, Jianwang Liu, Yueping Jiang, Dongsheng Cao, Shao Liu
pmc-13625653.description: Designing target-relevant molecules is particularly difficult when only limited bioactivity data are available. We present MMP2Mol, a ligand-based generative framework that combines matched molecular pair (MMP) analysis with a pretrained chemical language model (CLM). MMP2Mol extracts target-specific structure–activity transformations from available ligands, applies the prioritized transformations to construct a virtual focused library, and fine-tunes the CLM toward target-relevant chemical space.
